description: Hand-picked launch directories for a product type, grouped by when to submit (launch day first, evergreen after). Every pick carries a human-written verdict, including the ones that are not worth paying for, plus Ahrefs DR, link type and price. Start here; use find_launch_directories to go wider across all 1,666 sites.

free_only.description: Only picks with a free or freemium route

product_type.description: saas = B2B/B2C software, ai = AI tool or app, devtools = sold to developers, any = general

badgeExchange.description: The free listing asks for their badge on your site

dr.description: Ahrefs Domain Rating; 0 means no data, not worthless

drCheckedAt.description: Day the DR was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD); null = value from the last list sweep
